thread:
elaine: Quick proposal — I'd like to standardize a tiny bit of terminology in the glossary and update two SDK snippets while we're at it. Problem: we currently have `model_name` in some examples and `model` in others, and the phrasing around "response latency" vs "latency" is inconsistent across the Observability and API pages.

mike: Sounds reasonable. Where do you want to land on the param name? `model` is shorter but `model_name` is more explicit.

samira: My vote: `model` for SDK surface (js/py) and keep `model_name` in internal infra docs where we talk about db fields. Keeps public SDK concise.

toni: I can take the glossary edits. Quick question: do we want a short voice note in the docs about why we prefer `model` (clarity + parity with other providers)? Or just change snippets?

elaine: Good q — add a one-sentence rationale in the glossary entry (2 lines max). Something like: "Prefer `model` in public SDKs to keep examples succinct; use `model_name` where database or schema clarity is required." Keep tone factual, no marketing.

mike: For the SDK snippets I can open a tiny PR that updates both JS and Python examples and adds a deprecation note comment pointing to the glossary. Example patch I was thinking:

```js
// old
const resp = await client.generate({ model_name: 'redwood-1', prompt });
// new (preferred)
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt });
```

```py
# old
resp = client.generate(model_name='redwood-1', prompt=prompt)
# new (preferred)
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-1', prompt=prompt)
```

samira: Thanks — can you also add a one-line compatibility note for Dedicated/Private customers that map schema fields (db) -> SDK param? Something like: "If your internal schema uses `model_name`, mapping to `model` in the SDK is OK; both are accepted for now."

elaine: Yes, add that. We'll keep both accepted for 3 months and log a deprecation plan. Toni — can you add the glossary entry text and the single-sentence rationale? Also add the voice/tone blurb: "Use concise, neutral phrasing; avoid vendor-y adjectives in glossary definitions."

toni: On it. I'll draft the glossary entry in a PR and ping this thread. Plan for 2 small files: glossary.md update + docs/examples/sdk-params.md.

docs-bot: New PR opened by mike: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4721 — "SDK param rename: model_name -> model in examples"

mike: PR has JS + Py snippet updates, and a short note in examples/README. I left compatibility comment in the snippet and added a TODO with a target removal date (2026-06-30).

samira: Quick editorial: please avoid the phrase "deprecated" in customer-facing examples — use "legacy" or "older schemas" unless deprecation is official. We should reserve "deprecated" for formal deprecations with announcements and migration guides.

elaine: Good call. Change the comment to: `// also accepted for legacy schemas: model_name` and remove the word "deprecated".

mike: updated PR; replaced comment. Also added a tiny test in docs CI to check for both `model` and `model_name` in examples so link-rot / snippet sweeping doesn't reintroduce mismatches.

toni: Draft PR for glossary: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4722 — includes the one-sentence rationale and a voice note. I'll add a changelog line under docs/CHANGELOG.md for traceability.

essential: elle: Nice. Two more asks before merge: 1) docs owner review (assign to @samira), 2) quick nits pass for tone (assign to me). If both green we merge by EOD.

samira: I'll review now, will focus on wording and customer-facing phrasing.

docs-bot: PR 4721 CI passed \u2705

mike: Tagging @toni for glossary final review, then I'll merge the examples PR.

toni: Quick copy suggestion in glossary: replace "Prefer" with "Use" to be prescriptive and clearer. So: "Use `model` in public SDKs..."

essential: ela: Agreed — stronger is better for style guide entries.

samira: LGTM on both PRs except one tiny nit: in sdk-params.md line 18 change "latency" -> "response latency" where we mean end-to-end. I'll push that fix if OK.

mike: fine by me.

toni: Glossary PR updated, added changelog line, and included a link to a short migration checklist (internal-only).

essential: ela: Thanks everyone. Plan: merge examples PR after samira's quick pass; merge glossary + changelog after mike and I approve. I'll add a short note in #release-notes once merged. :thumbsup:

samira: Done — quick pass complete, wording tightened, approved.

mike: Merged 4721.

docs-bot: PR 4721 merged by mike at 2460012389

toni: Merged 4722 and added a follow-up issue to revisit phrasing for regionalized docs.

essential: ela: Closing loop — added a tiny runbook item to the docs style checklist: "verify sdk param naming parity across examples before merge". Filing as docs-tooling quick win. Thanks all. :rocket:
